disposition.delivery_interpretation: All four frozen relative gates passed; all eight runs completed 500/500. Candidate p95 increments were +2.391, -0.175, -1.250, +3.000 ms. Repeated v4 baseline p95 differed by 0.955 ms for 16-byte and 0.220 ms for 26-byte; no material baseline-order instability was visible in this fixed run. Quartile medians stayed flat, with no progressive backlog. All eight absolute p95 ages were below 100 ms, while maxima reached 168.083 ms and isolated deadline misses remain recorded. Host load and approximately 9.3 GiB swap were measured; the machine was not claimed isolated.
disposition.amd64: AMD64 functional qualification PASS under M4 emulation:12 focused native-kernel/boundary/fallback tests, five complete inputs across T0/T1/T2/T3 in operational and audit modes, both parser layouts and causal/reset/malformed smoke,40 inherited baseline tests and1730 original far checks. The clean-unpacked build also passes identity,12 focused,40 baseline and causal smoke checks. These are portability results; no emulated throughput or native-i7 performance claim is made. Native competition i7 remains UNMEASURED.
